thought.text: The obscurify keys are alive. Let me test the actual chat path and check how much balance remains across all keys.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && K=$(tail -1 ob_accounts.txt | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2}'); echo "=== chat completion test ==="; curl -s --max-time 90 https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"balas satu kata: ok"}],"max_tokens":20}' -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" | head -c 600

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && K=$(tail -1 ob_accounts.txt | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,\"\",$2); print $2}'); echo \"=== chat completion test ===\"; curl -s --max-time 90 https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"balas satu kata: ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":20}' -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" | head -c 600", "summary": "Test obscurify chat completions", "security_risk": "LOW"}
